title: AI-generated piano and orchestra pieces: YuE2 vs MiniMax-Music3 vs ACE-Step 1.5 XL vs direct LLM composition (prompts and costs included)
author: UnfortunateHurricane
selftext:
Hi,

I have been looking into generating instrumental pieces for game scores and standalone. 
I looked into text 2 music models (YuE2, MiniMax M3, AceStep 1.5 XL) as well as direct composition via LLM (I used paid frontier models, but local LLM might work too).

Disclaimer I have no music background and a bad ear in general. If you have a good ear and tell me it is bad, you are probably right.

Nevertheless, I thought the LLM piano compositions are pretty banger and wanted to share :-).
For piano the text2music models are pretty meh to my ears. For orchestral compositions they get better.

I will definitely invest more time into it direct generations. Please let me know what you think. (I have included the API prices for the generations, they each took a like 2-5% maybe of my weekly quota)

Take a listen here (you can Listen blind on each track if you prefer).

https://fmmix.github.io/ai-driven-music-composition/

https://github.com/fmmix/ai-driven-music-composition
